title: 5050 - FORCE MEDICAL SYMPOSIUM LOI

DEPARTMENT OF THE NAVY
COMMANDER NAVY RESERVE FORCES COMMAND
1915 FORRESTAL DRIVE
NORFOLK VA 23551-4615

N9

COMNAVRESFORCOM NOTICE 5050
From: Commander, Navy Reserve Forces Command
Subj: FORCE MEDICAL SYMPOSIUM LETTER OF INSTRUCTION
Ref: (a) RESPERSMAN 6000-010
(b) DoD 7000.14-R Volume 7A
(c) Joint Travel Regulations
1. Purpose. Provide information on the execution of the Commander, Navy Reserve Forces
Command (COMNAVRESFORCOM) Force Medical Symposium.
2. Background. The COMNAVRESFORCOM Force Surgeon is responsible for developing
health policies and issuing guidance for Navy Reserve Force health protection and management.
To establish absolute alignment with the Chief of Naval Operations' "Foundry, Fleet, Fight"
strategic vision, this symposium will restructure health protection guidance into three operational
pillars to ensure peak warfighter readiness as well as provide training to force medical personnel
per reference (a).
3. Scope and Applicability. This notice applies to all COMNAVRESFORCOM, Navy Reserve
Region Readiness and Mobilization Commands (REDCOM), Navy Reserve Centers (NRC), and
Strategic Sealift Officer force medical personnel.
4. Event Details
a. Date and Time: 20 April 2027, 0800. Event check-in will be conducted from 0715 to
0750 at the NRC Norfolk auditorium. REDCOM representatives will be available to assist their
respective attendees.
b. Location: NRC Norfolk Auditorium, One Navy Drive, Virginia Beach, Virgina 23455
c. Uniform: Navy Working Uniform, Type III
5. Transportation. The authorized travel dates are 19 April 2027 for arrival at Norfolk
International Airport and 23 April 2027 for departure. Travel dates and flights will not be
scheduled during the symposium. Each REDCOM is responsible for arranging transportation to
and from the airport for participants within their region.
COMNAVRESFORESCOMNOTE 5050
17 Nov 2026
2
Note: Attendees traveling from Alaska, Guam, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico, as well as
designated guest speakers, may be authorized alternate travel dates based on mission
requirements and applicable travel regulations.
a. Rental vehicles are authorized for designated duty drivers identified by REDCOM N9s.
One rental van per every six medical department representatives is authorized. Personnel who
obtain a rental vehicle outside of this requirement will be at the member’s expense and will not
be reimbursed. Duty drivers will provide transportation to and from the airport, lodging,
symposium, and meal locations.
b. Due to limited parking availability, all designated duty drivers will park in authorized
symposium parking spaces only.
c. Each REDCOM N9 must provide a consolidated list of designated duty drivers to HMC
Christopher Harris at CNRFC_FORCE_HEALTH_N9@us.navy.mil no later than
29 March 2027, 1500, eastern standard time.
6. Lodging. COMNAVRESFORCOM has reserved mandatory lodging for approved
participants at Navy Inn Little Creek, 1120 A Street, Virginia Beach, VA 23459. Each approved
attendee must contact the Department of Defense Reservation Center at 1-800-858-2128 to make
a reservation. Attendees must provide their name and Government Travel Charge Card
information and reference the group information in paragraph 6a through 6d. Reservations must
be completed no later than 29 March 2027.
a. Group Name: FORCE MEDICAL SYMPOSIUM
b. Group ID Number: 30230103860
c. Group Dates: 19 through 23 April 2027
d. Deadline: 29 March 2027
Note: Approved attendees traveling from Hawaii, Guam, Puerto Rico, and Alaska may
be authorized alternate travel dates of 18 and 24 April 2027, subject to approval and
applicable travel regulations.
7. Defense Travel System. Each attendee is responsible for making individual travel
reservations. Travel requests must be routed through the respective REDCOM N3 for approval.
Each REDCOM N3 will provide the appropriate line of accounting for authorized attendees.
COMNAVRESFORCOM has coordinated group lodging at Navy Inn Little Creek. Refer to
paragraph 6 for the group reservation information.
COMNAVRESFORESCOMNOTE 5050
17 Nov 2026
3
8. Dining. Full per diem is authorized and justified per references (b) and (c) for all in-person
attendees of the Force Medical Symposium. The symposium will be onboard Joint
Expeditionary Base Little Creek-Fort Story, Virginia. Due to transportation limitations, the
distance to available dining facilities and the symposium schedule, attendees may have limited
opportunities to access government dining facilities.
9. Records Management. Records created as a result of this notice regardless of media and
format, will be managed per Secretary of the Navy Manual 5210.1 of January 2019.
10. Cancellation Contingency. This notice will remain in effect until completion of the Force
Medical Symposium.
J. M. DROLL
Chief of Staff
Releasability and distribution:
This instruction is cleared for public release and is available only via Navy Reserve Web site
https://www.navyreserve.navy.mil/Resources/Official-RESFOR-Guidance/Notices/
